english.answer: His new phone malfunctioning, particularly with the navigation app.

window.speaker: Evan
window.text: Thanks, Sam! I usually paint what's on my mind or something I'm feeling. It can be good memories or places I wanna go to. It's more like expressing myself through art.

window.speaker: Sam
window.text: That's really amazing, Evan. Expressing yourself through art is such a powerful form of self-expression.

window.text: Thanks, Sam. Yeah, it's really a great way to express myself and my emotions. It's a cool way to communicate without using words. So, do you have any other ways in which you express yourself?

window.speaker: Sam
window.text: Drawing is cool. I'm still just learning how to draw, but I love expressing myself through writing. It's therapeutic and helps me sort out my feelings. Though, I've been a bit frustrated lately with my new phone. Its navigation app keeps malfunctioning, making getting around a bit of a challenge.

window.speaker: Evan
window.text: Cool, Sam! Writing is a great way to express yourself. What kind of writing do you enjoy? And about the phone, I recommend trying to update it, it usually works for me!

window.speaker: Sam
window.text: Thanks for the tip, Evan! Writing in my journal and doing creative writing is a good way for me to express my innermost thoughts and feelings.

window.speaker: Evan
window.text: It can be super therapeutic. It gives you a place to express yourself. Keep it up!

window.speaker: Sam
window.text: Hey Evan! I've been missing our chats. I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming. It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. On top of that, my phone's been giving me a hard time, adding to the stress.

window.speaker: Evan
window.text: Hey Sam, sorry to hear about that. Gastritis can be tough. Taking care of ourselves is important. BTW, I've been focusing on fitness and it's been really beneficial for my overall well-being. Funny thing, I had another encounter with a lost tourist recently. window.speaker: Sam
window.text: Thanks, Evan! Glad you've found that it's been good for you! I totally need to get into it too. Just getting started is hard - any tips for staying motivated? Also, you mentioned another lost tourist? Seems like you're becoming the go-to guy for tourists in need!

window.speaker: Evan
window.text: Yup, Sam! Set some goals, like a certain distance to run or number of push-ups to do. It'll give you something to strive for and stay motivated. Also, try to find an exercise that you enjoy and maybe even get a buddy for extra fun and accountability. Sound good?

chinese.question: 萨姆的手机一直存在什么问题？
chinese.answer: 他的新手机出现故障，尤其是导航应用。

window.speaker: 埃文
window.text: 谢谢，萨姆！我通常画我心里想的东西或者我的感受。可以是美好的回忆，或者我想去的地方。更像是通过艺术来表达自己。

window.speaker: 萨姆
window.text: 这真的很了不起，埃文。通过艺术来表达自己是一种非常有力的自我表达方式。

window.speaker: 埃文
window.text: 谢谢，萨姆。是啊，这确实是表达自己和情感的好方式。是一种不用语言就能交流的酷方法。那么，你有其他表达自己的方式吗？

window.speaker: 萨姆
window.text: 画画很酷。我还在学画画，但我喜欢通过写作来表达自己。这很治愈，能帮我理清情绪。不过，最近我对新手机有点恼火。它的导航应用老是出故障，让出行变得有点麻烦。

window.speaker: 埃文
window.text: 酷啊，萨姆！写作是表达自我的好方式。你喜欢写哪一类的东西？至于手机，我建议你试试更新系统，通常对我很管用！

window.speaker: 萨姆
window.text: 谢谢你的建议，埃文！写日记和进行创意写作是我表达内心想法和感受的好方式。

window.speaker: 埃文
window.text: 这会非常有治愈效果。它给了你一个表达自己的空间。坚持下去！

window.speaker: 萨姆
window.text: 嘿，埃文！我一直很想念我们聊天。上周末我的健康出了点大状况——因为剧烈的胃痛去了急诊室。结果发现是胃炎，还挺吓人的。这对我来说是个警钟，得开始重视健康了，比如吃得更营养、规律锻炼。另外，我的手机也一直给我添麻烦，压力更大了。

window.speaker: 埃文
window.text: 嘿，萨姆，听到这个很难过。胃炎确实不好受。照顾好自己很重要。对了，我最近一直在健身，对整体健康真的很有好处。有趣的是，我最近又遇到一个迷路的游客。帮助游客好像快成为我生活中的常态了！

window.speaker: 萨姆
window.text: 谢谢，埃文！很高兴你发现健身对你有好处！我也真的该开始锻炼了。只是万事开头难——有什么保持动力的小窍门吗？还有，你提到又遇到迷路游客了？看来你快成了游客求助的专业户了！

window.speaker: 埃文
window.text: 是的，萨姆！设定一些目标吧，比如跑一定的距离或者做一定数量的俯卧撑。这样你就有奋斗的目标，能保持动力。另外，试着找一项你喜欢的运动，甚至可以找个伙伴，既有趣又能互相监督。听起来不错吧？
